subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>; Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex / Sanjay,

Great to meet you both today. As promised, here's a short recap and proposed plan to get the POC (proof-of-concept) running next week so your engineering team can validate latency and cost under your expected workload.

Summary (from today's call)
- Goal: 2-week POC to validate LLM-based summarization at ~200 req/min and <250ms median token latency for 1k token prompts.
- Success criteria: throughput target (200 req/min sustained), median latency <250ms, model quality (ROUGE/precision on 30-run eval > baseline), and end-to-end integration (SSO + allowlist + API key).
- Stakeholders: Alex (engineering lead, Acme), Sanjay (procurement), Marissa (AE), Nikhil (solutions engineer), Monica (customer success).

Immediate next steps (proposed timeline)
1) Access & provisioning (by Mon, Jun 22): Redwood to provide test API key, SSO invite (Okta), and IP allowlist guidance. Acme to confirm static IPs to allow.
2) Integration & smoke tests (Tue-Wed, Jun 23-24): Acme infra runs a validation harness using our sample client.
3) Evaluation period (Thu-Fri, Jun 25-26): Run sustained load and gather metrics / sample outputs.
4) Review (Mon, Jun 29): 30-minute sync to review metrics and decide next steps.

Assigned ownership
- Redwood: Nikhil to provision API key and provide allowlist IPs / instructions; Monica to own runbook and quality evaluation script templates.
- Acme: Alex to provide static egress IP(s) and confirm Okta org for SSO invites; Sanjay to coordinate procurement for internal approvals if needed.

Attachments: I've attached a short activation guide and a success-criteria template to capture the exact tests we'll run.

Files attached: [Attachment: redwood-poc-activation-guide.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: acme-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (Excel)]

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Redwood-Acme-POC

Please confirm the timeline and who will be the primary technical contact for API access. If that's Alex, we'll send the Okta invite and the test API key once we get the domain and/or Okta org name.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
[Attachment: signature vCard]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. Timeline looks good from our side. A few quick items/questions: 

1) Okta: We are on Okta (acme.okta.com). Please send SSO invites to alex.johnson@acme.com. We'd prefer SAML SSO if that's supported.
2) IP allowlist: Our infra team can provide static egress IP block; I'll confirm the exact CIDR by end of day.
3) API key: For the POC, can we get a scoped test key with a 2-week expiry and rate-limits set to allow 500 req/min (we'll keep below this)? Also confirm whether the key will be usable from our staging environment and which headers we need to set.

Also looping in procurement (cc Sanjay), Sanjay, any internal approvals we should kick off now to avoid blocking the Mon start?

Appreciate the attachments, will review and confirm.

, Alex
Alex Johnson
Engineering Lead, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme POC: access, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks, can confirm: we support SAML via Okta for SSO. If you can share the Okta org name (you gave acme.okta.com, that's perfect) I'll send a SAML invite and the short setup steps.

API key & scope: We'll issue a scoped test API key (2-week TTL) limited to the POC models and usage. The key will include example curl and SDK headers (Authorization: Bearer <KEY>). You can use it from staging; if your staging egress IPs are static you can also lock the key to those IPs for security.

IP allowlist guidance: If you prefer explicit addresses for firewall rules, we recommend adding the following egress ranges for the POC endpoints (TCP 443):
- 34.82.12.45/32
- 34.82.12.46/32
- 34.82.13.0/24 (for burst testing)

I'll prepare the key and SAML invite once Marissa confirms. Monica will drop the evaluation script templates to the shared drive by EOD today.

Next: Marissa, is Monday start still OK? I can provision the key on Monday morning and send it via the secure key portal; we'll also attach the allowlist doc.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
